title: The do-while Loop
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of the do-while loop using at least one correct term from the lesson.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **The do-while Loop** as part of **Decision-Making and Loops**. Choose a loop form based on when the condition is checked and what is iterated; ranges and collection iteration make bounds and state changes explicit. Use the subtopics—Post-Condition Evaluation, Input Validation Loops, Choosing Between while and do-while—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Clear fundamentals help you reason about program behavior before adding abstraction. Small input/output checks make syntax and control flow easier to debug.
